definitions.full: H4571. maad [ מָעַד ] verb slip, slide, totter, shake (only Hebrew); — Qal Perfect 3plural מָֽעֲדוּ 2Sam 22:37 = Psa 18:37 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּמְעַד 37:31 ; אֶמְעָ֑ד 26:1 ; Participle plural construct מוֺעֲדֵי Job 12:5 ; — slip , subject feet, (figurative) 2Sam 22:37 = Psa 18:37 ; Job 12:5 ; subject אֲשֻׁרָיו Psa 37:31 ; compare 26:1 . Pu`al Participle מוּעָ֑דֶת ( = ׳מְמוּ Ges § 53s ; or old Qal Passive participle , — compare Ba NB 273 ; — but passive not needed here, read perhaps ׳מוֺ Qal Participle active see Schw ZAW x, 1890, 176 ); — מ ׳רֶגֶל Prov 25:19 (simile of untrustworthiness). Hiph`il Perfect וְהִמְעַדְתָּ֫ (so read for HCT והעמדת , compare Sm Co Da Berthol) Ezek 29:7 ; cause to shake object כָּלמָֿתְנַיִם , i.e. make them totter ; compare Imperative הַמְעַ֑ד (object id. ) Psa 69:24 .
